title: Choose the homepage composition
question: The visual world is fixed. Which composition makes Daniel's problem-solving approach clearest and most memorable?

options.label: Mode Statement
options.lineage: variable-font specimen with a vertical engineering axis
options.thesis: A single declarative phrase makes Daniel's range the first and largest idea.
options.viewport: One problem. Many modes. dominates the frame while a vertical discipline selector makes the range interactive.
options.risk: The offer depends on the supporting sentence being immediately visible and concise.

options.label: Problem Lens
options.lineage: variable type test bench with aligned discipline tracks
options.thesis: The visitor sees Daniel finding the right intervention across four technical modes.
options.viewport: Find the right intervention fills the left half; four live discipline tracks explain the breadth on the right.
options.risk: The denser right side needs disciplined responsive reduction on small screens.

options.label: Systems Sequence
options.lineage: typographic specimen wall with persistent reasoning coordinates
options.thesis: Different systems share one problem-solving method, expressed as a changing typographic sequence.
options.viewport: Different systems. Same approach. fills the canvas while problem, constraint, intervention, and outcome remain fixed at right.
options.risk: The vertical rail is distinctive but must collapse cleanly without stealing mobile width.
